title: Analista de planejamento financeiro Sênior
description:
A sua paixão por análise de dados e planejamento financeiro pode ter encontrado o ambiente ideal para crescer!

O time de FP&A (Financial Planning & Analysis) de um dos nossos clintes do setor bancário está em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar de forma estratégica no desenvolvimento de modelos, análises e relatórios que suportam a tomada de decisão da empresa.

Neste papel, você será responsável por:

  • Desenvolver e manter modelos de projeção financeira (curto, médio e longo prazo);
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento anual e realizar o forecast periódico;
  • Criar e aprimorar dashboards e relatórios gerenciais utilizando Excel avançado, Power BI ou ferramentas similares;
  • Realizar análises de variação (real vs. budget/forecast), identificando causas-raiz dos desvios e apresentando insights;
  • Garantir a integridade e consistência dos dados, atuando como um pilar de confiança nas informações gerenciais;
  • Apoiar diretamente a liderança com análises detalhadas e recomendações estratégicas.

O que você precisa para se destacar:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em instituições financeiras, com conhecimento em produtos financeiros de varejo (crédito imobiliário, veículos, entre outros);
  • Domínio em Excel avançado (fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros);
  • Vivência prática em modelagem financeira, projeções e análise de cenários;
  • Experiência com Power BI ou outras ferramentas de visualização de dados;
  • Trajetória sólida em processos de budget, forecast e análise de variação;
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para traduzir números em insights acionáveis para diferentes áreas.

Perfil comportamental desejado:

  • Analítico e orientado a resultados, com uma mente curiosa para descobrir o "porquê" por trás dos números;
  • Proativo, com iniciativa para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e otimização de processos;
  • Organizado, metódico e com extrema atenção aos detalhes;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com agilidade sob pressão e cumprir prazos desafiadores;
  • Visão estratégica, sempre conectando as análises aos objetivos de negócio.

Esta oportunidade é para você se:

Você é um(a) profissional que vai além do relatório, buscando o impacto real dos números. Se você combina profundidade técnica em finanças e ferramentas de análise com a capacidade de comunicar ideias de forma eficaz e apoiar decisões, queremos conhecê-lo(a)!

Interessado(a)?

Envie seu currículo ou conecte-se comigo por aqui para uma conversa inicial. Para detalhes mais específicos sobre o escopo da posição, também podemos conectar você diretamente com a gestora da área.

title: Analista de PCP Pleno
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO

Gerenciar os processos de planejamento de produção de latas e tampas da AMP Brasil do curto prazo, garantindo a otimização de nossos recursos e o capital empregado em nossos estoques, de acordo com os planos aprovados pela Diretoria.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atualizar os principais indicadores e relatórios da área, tais como: Ocupação de Estoque, Slow Moving, Aderência à Política de Estoque etc.;
  • Realizar o sequenciamento (scheduling) das linhas de produção de latas e tampas à nível SKU, de acordo com pedidos, política de estoque e/ou acordos comerciais, garantindo que as premissas e restrições operacionais estão sendo seguidas;
  • Analisar a disponibilidade de produto para atendimento de pedidos e negociar, quando necessário, a flexibilização dos prazos, seja com o time operacional, seja com Customer Service, garantindo a sinergia entre as necessidades da operação com as necessidades de nossos Clientes;
  • Atualizar os parâmetros de MRP para produtos acabados no SAP semanalmente, conforme variações identificadas;
  • Atualizar a programação de produção diarizada com base nos alinhamentos realizados com o time de operações para análises de atendimento, ocupação de estoque e consumo de insumos;
  • Conduzir o ciclo de planejamento de curto prazo (ITP) para latas e tampas à nível produto, com frequência semanal, analisando o cenário de atendimento da demanda, ocupação de estoque, aderência à política de estoque, alocação de estoque, deslocamentos de vendas e otimização de recursos, garantindo a eficiência do processo, bem como preparar o material e conduzir a reunião;
  • Fornecer projeções de estoque por cliente conforme necessidades dos times financeiro e/ou comercial;
  • Atuar como ponto focal da equipe de planejamento, garantindo que as operações de curto prazo estejam alinhadas com a estratégia definida para o médio e longo prazo, garantindo uma visão clara do que está acontecendo em todo o processo;

Requisitos:

  • Domínio avançado do Pacote Office
  • Experiência em planejamento

Sobre a Ardagh:

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

title: Senior Market Research Analyst
description:
About us:

At Toluna, we keep the world's biggest brands one step ahead of their markets, their competitors, and their customers. For 25+ years we've been a leader in consumer insights, and today we're at the center of our industry's biggest shift: the move to AI-powered research grounded in real human truth.

Brands come to us because we've solved a problem most of our industry is still wrestling with: how to move fast without losing trust in the answer. Speed comes from AI we've been developing in-house since 2019, always-on platforms, and a 79M+ validated consumer community across 100+ countries.

Introduction:

We are looking for a senior market research analyst to join our amazing team in Brazil! You are the ideal candidate for this role if you have at least 4 years of market research experience, ideally on the supplier side. In this position, you will be responsible for leading the full project life cycle, from set-up through client presentations.

You'll work across multiple research methodologies within Product & Innovation (idea and concept testing, market exploration, and packaging testing) and Brand & Communication (advertising testing, media and campaign effectiveness, brand assessment) in a dynamic environment, where AI-powered solutions are already a reality.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and execution of research projects to meet complex needs with minimal support.
  • Independently manage medium-to-highly complex quantitative & qualitative studies across a variety of methodologies from survey design through final delivery to clients.
  • Develop compelling, story-led analyses and final reports with strategic, clear, and engaging client presentations.
  • Responsible for leading final client presentations, providing consistent, clear, and actionable recommendations.
  • Manage all client communications, providing clear and proactive communication regarding project progress.
  • Manage multiple projects at once in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work together with project managers and operations for deployment and execution while maintaining overall management of timelines.
  • Share your expertise with junior and mid-level research analysts, acting as a knowledge multiplier and recognized as a strong technical contributor within the team.

Your profile:

  • Bachelor's degree and at least 4 years of market research experience.
  • Experience in various research methodologies such as ad-hoc, ad concept testing, ad pre-testing, campaign evaluation, pack testing, brand tracking, shopper research, segmentation, U&A, iHUTs, etc.
  • Demonstrated success in questionnaire design, analysis, client presentation, and project management.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop effective working relationships with both internal partners and external clients.
  • Languages: English proficiency is mandatory; additional language skills are a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with an ability to multitask and effectively prioritize own workload.

**Please submit your CV in English

Our Values:

Acting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability

Bringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial

Collaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness

Discussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly

Embracing empathy- Being egoless & caring

What we offer:

At Toluna, we're all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you're passionate about making an impact, we'd love to have you on board.

Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal voucher, transportation voucher, TotalPass and language class subsidy.

Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

Como Analista Pleno de Controle de Materiais você será responsável por realizar o controle e acompanhamento de materiais nacionais e importados, garantindo a disponibilidade dos itens conforme a demanda da operação. Será responsável pelo acompanhamento de estoques, pedidos e prazos de entrega, interface com fornecedores e áreas internas, além da identificação e tratativa de possíveis desvios no abastecimento.

Principais Atividades:

  • Gestão de estoque: Monitorar níveis de estoque para evitar faltas ou excessos tanto de componentes quanto de produto acabado.
  • Planejamento de materiais: Garantir disponibilidade conforme demanda de produção.
  • Controle de inventário: Realizar contagens cíclicas e inventários físicos conforme procedimentos da empresa.
  • Análise de consumo: Avaliar histórico e demandas futuras para controle de compra e espaço de armazenagem.
  • Gestão de peças NG: Identificar e tratar materiais conforme procedimentos da empresa.
  • Planejamento de demanda: Elaborar previsões baseadas em demandas via SAP.
  • Programação de produção: Alinhar cronogramas com disponibilidade de materiais junto as áreas produtivas.
  • Gestão de fornecedores: Acompanhar entregas e prazos para evitar rupturas.
  • Controle de lead time: Monitorar tempos de reposição de estoques, transporte etc.
  • Gestão de transporte: Coordenar movimentação interna e externa de materiais e controlar Milk Run junto a parceiros.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Superior em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Inglês intermediário ou acima;
  • Solida experiencia nas áreas de Materiais e Logística;
  • Conhecimentos em SAP, pacote office, especialmente Excel, Power Point e Power Apps;
  • Domínio das ferramentas de análise e solução de problemas;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no office e chão de fábrica.

Será um Diferencial:

  • Experiência com ferramentas Lean;
  • Experiencia com Logística automotiva em atividades de recebimento, armazenagem e abastecimento de linha de produção;
  • Domínio de Power BI e ferramentas de IA .

title: Analista de Consolidação Sênior
description:
Sobre a QMC Telecom Internacional

A QMC Telecom Internacional é uma multinacional de infraestrutura de telecomunicações com operações no Brasil, México, Colômbia, Chile e Peru. O Brasil é nossa maior operação e centro estratégico da plataforma latino-americana.

Desenvolvemos, operamos e cedemos infraestrutura de conectividade móvel, incluindo Sistemas de Antenas Distribuídas (DAS), Street Level Solutions (SLS), torres e rooftops para cobertura outdoor.

Atuamos em um setor dinâmico, com cultura orientada a resultados e times que combinam visão regional com execução local.

Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Consolidação Sênior para atuação no Brasil, com escopo global para as empresas do grupo QMC. Localidade em São Paulo – Brasil, em modelo híbrido.

A posição será responsável pela consolidação das demonstrações financeiras das empresas do grupo, pela análise das informações contábeis e pela elaboração de relatórios que apoiem a tomada de decisão gerencial.

O profissional também atuará no acompanhamento de auditorias, na conciliação de saldos contábeis, na avaliação de impactos decorrentes de alterações nas normas contábeis e no desenvolvimento de ferramentas para automação e melhoria das análises.

Responsabilidades

Consolidação e análise contábil:

  • Assegurar que as demonstrações financeiras sejam corretamente consolidadas;
  • Analisar informações contábeis e elaborar relatórios específicos e eventuais;
  • Preparar explicações sobre resultados e variações patrimoniais das empresas ou grupos sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Fornecer informações contábeis precisas para apoiar a tomada de decisão gerencial.

Controles e fechamento contábil:

  • Monitorar a adoção uniforme de procedimentos e políticas contábeis nas empresas do grupo;
  • Avaliar e documentar eventuais diferenças na aplicação de procedimentos e políticas;
  • Salvaguardar os mapeamentos de contas dos relatórios analíticos para os sintéticos;
  • Avaliar inconsistências de classificação;
  • Conciliar mensalmente os saldos contábeis societários e gerenciais;
  • Desenvolver o fluxo de informações contábeis, garantindo o envio correto das informações às partes interessadas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

Auditoria, normas e temas fiscais:

  • Participar e acompanhar atividades de auditoria;
  • Garantir que relatórios e registros contábeis estejam de acordo com os princípios, normas contábeis e legislação aplicável;
  • Avaliar novos processos de contabilização e alterações nas normas;
  • Reportar tempestivamente os impactos das alterações nos processos de fechamento e/ou no resultado da empresa;
  • Realizar atividades contábeis e apoiar a consultoria em temas fiscais e no controle do imposto de renda.

Processos, automação e ferramentas de análise:

  • Desenvolver ferramentas e painéis de controle para automatizar processos e melhorar a qualidade das análises;
  • Apoiar e desenvolver melhorias em processos, rotinas, organização do trabalho e controles operacionais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de produtividade e eficiência;
  • Implementar controles e relatórios;
  • Propor e desenvolver ferramentas de análise para agilizar a tomada de decisão;
  • Contribuir para uma visão clara dos resultados operacionais atuais e futuros.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Ensino superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração, Economia ou áreas afins.

Experiência Profissional

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em posições relacionadas à área de Contabilidade;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de relatórios gerenciais e corporativos;
  • Experiência em consolidação contábil será considerada diferencial;

title: Production Engineer - Wireless Industrialization and Tax Processes Specialist
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Production Engineer or Industrialization Specialist to support the development and implementation of local manufacturing and assembly strategies for ZTE's telecommunications products in Brazil.

The primary focus of this position will be to evaluate and enable the local production of Wireless RAN and Microwave (MW) equipment, including radio units, baseband units, antennas, transmission equipment, cabinets, power systems, accessories, and related components.

This professional will act as a key interface among Engineering, Product Management, Procurement, Supply Chain, Tax, Logistics, Finance, local manufacturing partners, and ZTE's global teams.

The position requires a combination of industrial engineering, product-cost analysis, tax knowledge, and project coordination. The professional will be responsible for developing feasible local-production models, ensuring compliance with Brazilian industrial and tax regulations, and evaluating the effects of the Brazilian Tax Reform on manufacturing costs, tax credits, sourcing strategies, and product competitiveness.

Main Responsibilities

Local Production and Industrialization

  • Evaluate Wireless RAN and Microwave product families for potential local manufacturing, assembly, integration, configuration, testing, and repair in Brazil.
  • Develop industrialization strategies for radio units, baseband equipment, antennas, microwave radios, indoor and outdoor units, cabinets, power systems, and related telecom products.
  • Analyze different production models, including local manufacturing, outsourced manufacturing, contract manufacturing, CKD/SKD assembly, and partial localization of components.
  • Coordinate the implementation of local production projects from feasibility study through pilot production and mass production.
  • Define production workflows, assembly sequences, testing procedures, quality checkpoints, required tooling, labor demand, and factory capacity.
  • Prepare industrial process flowcharts, work instructions, technical reports, and project documentation.
  • Support prototype, pilot, first-article, and production-validation activities.
  • Monitor production performance, lead time, yield, quality indicators, manufacturing costs, and corrective-action plans.

Product Localization and Cost Analysis

  • Review product BOMs to identify opportunities for local sourcing, component substitution, process simplification, and cost reduction.
  • Develop localization roadmaps for selected Wireless RAN and Microwave products.
  • Perform make-or-buy analyses and compare imported-product costs with local-production scenarios.
  • Prepare business cases covering investment requirements, production volume, manufacturing costs, tax impacts, logistics costs, and expected financial returns.
  • Identify Brazilian suppliers and manufacturing partners capable of meeting ZTE's technical, quality, cost, capacity, and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate technical alignment between Brazilian suppliers, outsourced factories, and ZTE's global R&D and product teams.
  • Support negotiations with contract manufacturers and monitor their operational and contractual performance.

PPB, Regulatory Compliance and Incentives

  • Analyze and implement applicable Basic Productive Process (PPB) requirements for telecommunications and electronic products.
  • Evaluate industrial and regional incentive structures, including projects involving SUFRAMA and the Manaus Free Trade Zone, when applicable.
  • Monitor compliance with production stages, local-content requirements, investment commitments, documentation, and traceability obligations.
  • Support applications, technical projects, reports, and evidence required by government authorities and incentive programs.
  • Ensure alignment among BOM structure, manufacturing processes, import records, production orders, inventories, and tax documentation.
  • Support ANATEL-related product-compliance activities when they interact with industrialization, local configuration, or product modifications.
  • Assist internal and external audits and inspections conducted by SUFRAMA, Receita Federal, SEFAZ, and other regulatory authorities.

Tax Processes and Brazilian Tax Reform

  • Evaluate the tax impacts of local production versus importation for Wireless RAN and Microwave products.
  • Support the correct classification of products, components, kits, and raw materials under the NCM.
  • Coordinate the preparation and validation of the FCI – Import Content Statement, when applicable.
  • Work closely with the Tax team to ensure the correct application and recovery of tax credits throughout the manufacturing and supply chain.
  • Analyze the effects of Brazil's Tax Reform on industrialization projects, particularly the transition from the current tax system to CBS and IBS.
  • Assess how the new tax-credit model may affect product costs, local sourcing, contract manufacturing, inventory flows, transfers, imports, sales, and customer pricing.
  • Monitor the coexistence of legacy taxes and the new consumption-tax system during the transition period.
  • Support adaptations to ERP, costing, purchasing, inventory, invoicing, and tax-control processes required by the Tax Reform.
  • Analyze the effects of ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, CBS, IBS and, when applicable, the Selective Tax and regional tax incentives on industrial projects.
  • Maintain documentation and calculation models that allow ZTE to compare tax burdens and credit utilization under different production and sourcing scenarios.
  • Work with Tax, Finance, IT, and ERP teams to ensure the traceability of tax credits from component acquisition through production and final sale.
  • Monitor regulatory changes that may affect PPB rules, Manaus Free Trade Zone incentives, local manufacturing, imported content, or telecom-equipment taxation.

Systems, Inventory and Process Integration

  • Support the configuration and continuous improvement of industrial, inventory, purchasing, costing, and tax processes in ERP systems.
  • Ensure consistency among engineering BOMs, production BOMs, purchase orders, import systems, warehouse balances, production orders, and accounting records.
  • Support integrations and reconciliations involving PROTHEUS, SAP, WMS, import-management systems, and other internal platforms.
  • Identify process gaps that may generate incorrect inventory balances, tax-credit losses, production delays, or accounting inconsistencies.
  • Participate in automation, data-analysis, and artificial-intelligence initiatives aimed at improving industrial planning, tax controls, documentation, and operational productivity.

Project Management and Cross-functional Coordination

  • Lead cross-functional industrialization projects involving Engineering, Product, Procurement, Supply Chain, Tax, Finance, Logistics, Quality, IT, and external manufacturing partners.
  • Develop project schedules, define responsibilities, monitor deliverables, and report risks and progress to management.
  • Coordinate technical and commercial discussions with ZTE headquarters and international product teams.
  • Translate global product and manufacturing requirements into processes compatible with Brazilian industrial, tax, and regulatory conditions.
  • Present recommendations, business cases, risks, and project results to local and global leadership.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in industrialization, manufacturing engineering, production-process implementation, or local assembly of electronic or telecommunications products.
  • Experience with BOM analysis, production workflows, cost structures, and outsourced manufacturing.
  • Practical knowledge of Brazilian taxes and industrial regulations related to manufacturing, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, NCM, FCI, and PPB.
  • Knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its main operational impacts, especially CBS, IBS, tax-credit traceability, and the transition between tax systems.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including cost simulations, scenario analysis, reconciliations, and data processing.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering specifications, BOMs, production documents, tax legislation, and regulatory requirements.
  • Intermediate or advanced English for meetings, technical discussions, documentation, and interaction with ZTE's global teams.
  • Availability to visit suppliers, factories, warehouses, and production partners when required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with Wireless RAN, Microwave, telecommunications infrastructure, or radio-frequency equipment.
  • Knowledge of the architecture and main components of radio access and microwave-transmission systems.
  • Previous experience in the localization or nationalization of telecom or electronic products.
  • Experience with contract manufacturers, electronics manufacturing services, CKD/SKD operations, or outsourced assembly.
  • Experience with PPB projects, SUFRAMA, the Manaus Free Trade Zone, or other Brazilian industrial-incentive programs.
  • Knowledge of PROTHEUS, SAP, WMS, MES, PLM, or other ERP and manufacturing systems.
  • Familiarity with product-costing methodologies, standard cost, landed cost, and manufacturing variance analysis.

Nós somos uma consultoria de recrutamento especializado e estamos apoiando nosso cliente, que é uma das empresas de tecnologia mais inovadoras e conhecidas do mundo, a construir o time de HR Operations no Brasil.

HR Operations cuida da experiência de quem trabalha na empresa, do primeiro ao último dia: o atendimento das dúvidas do dia a dia, a qualidade dos processos de pessoas e as questões trabalhistas da região. O time atende colaboradores da América Latina e da América do Norte.

Pontos importantes a considerar antes da sua candidatura:

Inglês avançado ou fluente. Boa parte das pessoas com quem você fala no dia a dia não fala português, e o inglês é usado o tempo todo, em conversas e por escrito.

Entre 1 e 3 anos de experiência profissional. É a faixa em que a posição foi desenhada, e o que pesa aqui é o que você já fez no dia a dia, em atendimento, suporte ou RH.

Presencial cinco dias por semana, no escritório de São Paulo.

Graduação completa em Recursos Humanos, Psicologia, Administração, Engenharia, Direito ou áreas correlatas.

O que faz: responde às dúvidas dos colaboradores da região pelo sistema interno de chamados, com precisão e dentro do prazo, conduzindo vários atendimentos em paralelo. Pesquisa os casos que exigem mais contexto, encaminha os complexos ao time especialista e registra cada solicitação conforme o procedimento. Ajuda a manter a base de conhecimento da área e sugere melhorias quando identifica um processo que trava.

O que buscamos: experiência em atendimento ao colaborador, centro de serviços compartilhados de RH, service desk ou BPO. Quem vem de atendimento bilíngue ou de suporte em ambiente internacional se adapta rápido. Domínio de pacote Office e familiaridade com sistemas de RH.

O momento da área:

O time está sendo montado agora e os processos ainda estão sendo desenhados. Quem entra participa desse desenho e conversa direto com os times do Brasil e com os times globais. A operação brasileira está em expansão e a área de RH está ganhando escala, então quem chega agora acompanha esse crescimento de perto.

Sobre inclusão:

A empresa tem compromisso público com diversidade e inclusão. Este time está sendo formado com profissionais PCD desde as primeiras contratações, junto com a construção da área.

Condições: Contratação efetiva, CLT. Remuneração atrativa, acima das condições normais de mercado para o nível.

Como funciona: Vamos entrar em contato com as pessoas candidatas cujo perfil profissional seja aderente com as necessidades do nosso cliente para esta seleção. Na entrevista, entendemos sua trajetória e próximos passos (entrevistas) junto a nosso cliente.

Candidate-se por aqui. O processo está avançando rápido.

title: Cost Controller
description:
Our organization is hiring for an experienced Cost Controller in Rio. The Cost Controller is responsible for managing and monitoring project and operational costs to ensure alignment with budget and financial objectives. The role includes preparing and maintaining budgets and forecasts, conducting cost and variance analysis, tracking expenditures, identifying financial risks and cost-saving opportunities, and providing accurate financial reporting to support decision-making. The Cost Controller works closely with operational and finance teams to enhance cost visibility, ensure compliance with financial controls and company policies, and drive financial performance through effective cost management and resource utilization.

The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.

**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Develop, maintain, and monitor project and operational budgets
  • Prepare periodic forecasts and analyze budget versus actual performance
  • Track and control costs to ensure adherence to approved budgets
  • Perform detailed variance analysis and provide explanations for cost deviations
  • Prepare accurate and timely financial reports, dashboards, and management summaries
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and recommend corrective actions to improve financial performance
  • Monitor project commitments, accruals, and expenditures to ensure financial accuracy
  • Collaborate with operational, project, procurement, and finance teams to support cost management initiatives

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in cost control, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, or project accounting
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and financial reporting skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Dynamics)
  • Knowledge of budgeting, cost management, variance analysis, and financial controls
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Ability to identify financial risks and cost-saving opportunities
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities
  • Advanced English proficiency in multinational environments
  • Professional certifications (CMA, CPA, CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent) are a plus

title: Analista Jr Processos Comerciais e Projetos
description:
Você quer participar da transformação do saneamento no Brasil?

Buscamos pessoas que, assim como nós, têm vontade de ir além do básico para aplicar seus conhecimentos em um setor que está mudando a vida de milhões de brasileiros e brasileiras. Na BRK, respeito, diversidade e inclusão são valores inegociáveis! Atuamos para promover um ambiente positivo, inovador, ético, inclusivo, seguro e de respeito às pessoas.

Se você sempre quis trabalhar com propósito, temos uma oportunidade que pode te interessar:

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar processos comerciais.

  • Apoiar iniciativas de automação e digitalização de processos.
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas corporativas e operacionais na implantação de melhorias.
  • Elaborar fluxos, procedimentos e documentação técnica.
  • Promover a cultura de gestão por indicadores, governança de processos e melhoria contínua..

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Ensino Superior completo ou em fase final de conclusão em Administração, Economia, Gestão Comercial, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Facilities, preferencialmente nos segmentos de energia, saneamento ou prestadores de serviços, como empresas de telefonia.
  • Vivência nas áreas de Comercial, Finanças ou Economia.
  • Excel avançado, incluindo Tabela Dinâmica e gráficos.
  • Conhecimento em PowerPoint.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI, sendo que o nível será avaliado durante o processo.
  • Experiência com análise de dados e construção de dashboards.
  • Conhecimento em gestão e melhoria de processos (BPM, PDCA, Lean ou similares).
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos e acompanhamento de cronogramas.
  • Experiência na elaboração de apresentações executivas.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), metas e resultados.
  • Organização de informações e utilização de sistemas corporativos.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação no modelo híbrido: 4 dias presenciais e 1 dia em home office, na região da Zona Sul de São Paulo, próximo à Estação Morumbi da CPTM.

O que oferecemos:

Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Vale Refeição ou Alimentação, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, Programa de Apoio à Saúde, Gympass, DayOff, Licença Maternidade ou Paternidade estendida, PLR; modelo híbrido de trabalho (4x1);

+ Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo.

A BRK é uma das maiores empresas privadas de saneamento do país e está presente em 13 estados e mais de 100 municípios, beneficiando a vida de mais de 16 milhões de pessoas. Investimos e operamos sistemas de água e esgoto, fornecendo um serviço que faz toda a diferença para a saúde e o bem-estar da população.

A BRK e seus acionistas estão comprometidos com um modelo de gestão ESG (da sigla em inglês para Meio Ambiente, Social e Governança), incorporando esta estratégia à tomada de decisões da companhia e à prestação de serviços.

Este é o nosso jeito de contribuir para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuamos e de transformar a vida de milhões de pessoas levando o saneamento para muito além do básico!

VEM SER BRK!

title: Visual Designer
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a Visual Designer who will be responsible for communicating and visually creating for social media, apps, and websites for the New Games team.

If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we'd love to work with you!

Make sure to share your CV in English and attach the link to your portfolio in it.

Exclusivity contract required.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring excellence in visual communication, both static and animated, for the brand of the New Games and partners, through research and the use of design and branding resources, while ensuring the most current graphic design practices.
  • Creating visual identities for Garena's product, which are further developed into various elements, whether printed and/or digital, using Adobe Suite and other design tools for production.
  • Sharing new visual trends and improvements in the platform interface based on audience behavior, understanding the needs of the current platform users, and identifying new opportunities for engagement.
  • Developing the Style Guides and Brand Books, collaborating with marketing teams to ensure the best application of the brand, and guiding internal and external partners in the use of new product logos and elements.
  • Creative Social Media Content Creator responsible for designing engaging content across platforms to boost online presence and brand awareness. (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Youtube)
  • Visual Identity Designer for New Games, specializing in crafting compelling visual concepts tailored to resonate with the Brazilian market.

Main job requirements:

  • Completed superior degree;
  • 1+ year experience with visual design, illustration, visual interface development and concept creation.
  • Proficiency in visual editing software including Adobe Suite, Motion Design, and Animation software.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and advanced English skills (written and spoken)
  • Active gamer and passionate about the gaming universe;
  • Available to work in hybrid mode at our office in São Paulo, SP.

Desirable knowledge:

  • Knowledge of the games and entertainment industry

title: Analista Fiscal Sênior (Impostos Diretos e Indiretos)
description:
China Mobile International Brazil is seeking a Tax Executive to join our growing team in Brazil. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and supporting the company's tax activities, ensuring accurate tax calculations, compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, timely submission of tax obligations, and proper management of tax-related documentation and processes.

The Tax professional will work closely with internal departments, external accounting firms, clients, vendors, and government authorities to ensure tax compliance, support business operations, and identify solutions to tax-related matters.

Work Location: Paulista Area, São Paulo

Work Model: 100% On-site

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform tax calculations and verify assessed taxes, including ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, DIFAL, IRPJ, CSLL, FUST, FUNTTEL, and withholding taxes, requesting corrections whenever necessary.
  • Prepare and submit ancillary tax obligations, such as GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, DIRF, among others.
  • Collaborate with external accounting firms throughout the tax assessment process by providing accurate and timely information and documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits by gathering, reviewing, and providing all required documentation and information.
  • Keep tax clearance certificates up to date to support participation in public tenders and ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements.
  • Issue, review, and submit to clients invoices related to services, goods, rentals, imports, exports, and telecommunications.
  • Record and approve incoming invoices, verifying tax information and fiscal classifications, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Prepare tax payment slips, such as DARF, DARE, DARJ, and GNRE, among others, in coordination with the central payments team.
  • Validate tax and fiscal information related to REIDI.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting closings and directly perform the tax closing process, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of the information.
  • Maintain relationships with government authorities, including the Receita Federal, SEFAZ, City Halls, and other relevant government agencies.
  • Provide tax support to other departments by addressing and clarifying tax-related questions from employees, vendors, and clients.
  • Participate in internal projects by providing tax guidance and proposing solutions to ensure tax compliance and operational efficiency.
  • Prepare and submit IBGE reports on an annual basis, DICI reports on a monthly basis, and CODEF reports on a semi-annual basis.
  • Coordinate the tax and fiscal procedures related to the nationalization of imported services and products, ensuring compliance with applicable Brazilian tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Organize and maintain reports and records of all invoices issued by the company.
  • Coordinate and follow up on tax-related matters with related parties and internal/external stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Previous experience with direct and indirect tax assessment, including ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL, and other applicable taxes.
  • Proficiency in preparing and submitting ancillary tax obligations, including GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, and DIRF.
  • Solid knowledge of fiscal classification, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Experience issuing, reviewing, and recording incoming and outgoing invoices.
  • Experience with tax and fiscal processes related to imports and exports is preferred.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its potential impacts on the company's operations.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Note:

  • Position offered shall be determined by the candidate's years of relevant experience and skillsets.
  • All personal data collected will be used for recruitment and employment-related purpose only.

experiência em consultoria de vendas e consultoria ao cliente com foco em entendimento de necessidades, orientação adequada e construção de relacionamento.

forte orientação para satisfação do cliente e excelência em atendimento garantindo resolução de demandas e acompanhamento pós-venda.

habilidades de comunicação clara objetiva e respeitosa tanto presencialmente quanto por telefone e meios digitais.

desejável experiência prévia em vendas em veiculos ou no varejo conhecimento básico de negociação e técnicas de vendas.

title: Import Export Specialist
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Trade & Compliance Specialist processes Move Order Requests (MORs) raised from the client's and third-party warehouses across multiple locations and ensures that every shipment's commercial and trade documentation is in place and compliant with shipping practice. The role carries the deep trade-compliance expertise behind the operation — managing customs clearance, ATA Carnets, dangerous goods, brokerage performance and emerging-markets shipping research — on a 16x5 hybrid model that combines onsite presence with remote processing.

Day to day, the specialist reviews and approves commercial invoices, manages location codes within the client's commercial-invoice tooling, resolves inbound shipments stuck at customs, and produces the monthly compliance reporting and audit tracking the service requires — all in line with the logistics & compliance handbook. The role partners with Order Management, logistics and the client's compliance point of contact, escalating regulatory questions where a ruling is needed.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Move Order Request (MOR) Processing

  • Manage and process Move Order Requests (MORs) and supply-chain portal requests from initial receipt through to confirmed delivery by the carrier
  • Review Order Form entries in the relevant order systems for correct entities, Incoterms and shipment details, and update order status for non-inventory shipments via the client's ticketing system.
  • Track and update fulfillment statuses for non-inventory shipments within the enterprise ticketing and order-tracking tools.
  • Monitor backlogs to proactively flag delayed shipments, identify transit issues early, and initiate swift corrective actions.

2. Trade Documentation & Compliance

  • Review and ensure all commercial documents connected with MORs are present and compliant with shipping practice, creating manual trade documents where needed.
  • Review and approve commercial invoices generated for the various order types.
  • Process, coordinate, and manage ATA Carnets globally to facilitate temporary cross-border movements of corporate hardware and demonstration equipment.
  • Draft manual trade and customs clearance documents when automated system pipelines face data errors or exceptions.
  • Conduct proactive regulatory research into shipping laws, import/export restrictions, and tax liabilities for new or expanding global delivery locations.

3. Customs & Dangerous Goods

  • Act as the primary escalation point to coordinate, troubleshoot, and resolve international inbound shipments blocked or held at global customs borders
  • Govern and approve the shipment of hazardous or restricted commodities (specifically lithium-ion batteries) globally, providing strict packaging, safety labeling, and carrier declaration guidance
  • Maintain strict database accuracy by managing location-code data and regional entity mappings within the commercial-invoice tooling.

4. Brokerage, Reporting & Continuous Compliance

  • Compile brokerage performance metrics, track transportation costs, and maintain a country-by-country compliance audit ledger to support internal audits. Maintain brokerage performance reports and manage transportation cost and performance reporting as requested.
  • Generate and present monthly reports — tickets and bugs resolved, average resolution and acknowledgment times, logistics-documentation updates, and the country-compliance audit tracker.
  • Assist the compliance manager in developing and maintaining transportation programs across regions, and provide location-code management within the client's commercial-invoice tool.
  • Comply with the processes, procedures and instructions set out in the logistics & compliance handbook, and identify and escalate system performance issues to the local support team.

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS

Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured by location per service line.

  • Ticket Response by Priority: respond within 1 hour for P0 (urgent/high), 3 hours for P1 (normal), and 6 hours for P2/P3/P4 (low), across all regional tickets and bugs in scope.
  • Assignment Accuracy: maintain correct HS codes, ECCN designations and Certificates of Origin on ≥99% of in-scope hardware shipments.
  • Customs Compliance: keep 100% of shipments compliant with the client's policy and customs law, evidenced through the audit tracker.
  • Reporting Cadence: deliver monthly performance and compliance reports on time, with the country-compliance audit tracker kept current.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS

  • ERP Platforms: SAP (specifically Procure-to-Pay, Materials Management, and Trade Processing modules).
  • Global Logistics & Order Tools: Enterprise order-management systems, global carrier booking consoles (FedEx, DHL, freight forwarders), and warehouse portal interfaces.
  • Compliance & Invoicing Tooling: Automatic commercial-invoice generators, centralized location-code registries, and compliance database trackers.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Mandatory

  • 3–7+ years of experience in international trade, customs compliance, global logistics, or cross-border supply-chain operations.
  • Expert-level command of global import/export regulations, Harmonized System (HS) classifications, ECCN codes, Incoterms (DDP vs. DAP), and Importer/Exporter of Record (IOR/EOR) liabilities.
  • Proven experience reviewing commercial invoices and creating compliant international trade paperwork across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and AMER regions.
  • Hands-on experience interpreting transport regulations for dangerous goods and hazardous cargos (specifically IATA/ADR battery compliance.
  • Commercial-invoice review and trade-documentation experience across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Clear English communication and audit-ready documentation discipline.

Preferred

  • Licensed customs-broker exposure or formal customs training.
  • Dangerous Goods (IATA / IMDG) certification.
  • Experience using SAP Trade/Logistics modules, international shipping portals, and automated commercial-invoice generators.
  • Emerging-markets trade experience and familiarity with global order-management and trade systems.

LEVELS & PROGRESSION (I – III)

One job profile spans the levels below; seniority (and compensation) is differentiated by scope, autonomy and ownership. The JD itself is common across levels.

  • Level II — processes MORs, prepares and reviews trade documents, and handles DG approvals within established procedures.
  • Level III — is the trade-compliance SME and line lead — owning customs escalations, brokerage governance, regional transportation programs, emerging-markets research and audit defense.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.

Position Overview

VelaFi Brazil is seeking an independent Internal Auditor to establish and execute our internal audit framework required for Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) VASP/PSAV authorization under Resolution BCB No. 552/2025.

In this role, you will objectively evaluate the effectiveness of our governance, risk management processes, AML/CFT controls (Circular BCB No. 3,978/2020), cybersecurity measures, and cross-border payment operations.

Location

Hybrid: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Audit Plan & Execution: Design and execute an annual risk-based internal audit plan approved by the Board of Directors.
  • AML/CFT & Regulatory Testing: Conduct independent testing of AML/CFT controls (KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, sanctions/PEP screening, SAR/ROS procedures).
  • Custody & Segregation Review: Evaluate asset segregation and digital asset custody controls in compliance with BCB regulations (e.g., Res. BCB 520).
  • Cybersecurity & Tech Audits: Assess IT controls, key management, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Business Continuity (BCP), and Disaster Recovery (DRP) frameworks (Res. BCB 552 / Res. BCB 85).
  • Reporting & Escalation: Report findings, control deficiencies, and remediation status directly to the Board. Support mock regulatory audits and pre-filing BCB readiness reviews.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Proven experience in internal/external audit or risk assurance within financial institutions, payment institutions (IP), or licensed VASPs/crypto entities in Brazil.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the BCB regulatory framework (Res. BCB 552, Circ. 3,978/2020).
  • Certifications: CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA, CPA, or equivalent credentials preferred.
  • Languages: Professional fluency in English and Portuguese.

Desired Competencies

  • Financial Controls & Governance: Strong expertise in evaluating internal control frameworks, corporate governance, operational workflows, and segregation of customer assets.
  • Regulatory Reporting & Audit Expertise: Familiarity with BCB audit requirements and regulatory systems, including Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), COSIF accounting frameworks, and AML/CFT compliance.
  • Executive Presence & Independence: Ability to report directly and present objective findings to the Board of Directors and external regulators without operational bias.
  • Strong Analytical & Decision-Making Skills: Demonstrated skill in conducting root-cause analyses, dissecting complex transaction logs, and identifying systemic control gaps.
  • High Accountability & Ownership: Results-driven approach to tracking audit remediation plans and ensuring timely resolution of audit findings.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to collaborate constructively with Compliance, Risk, Engineering, and Finance teams while maintaining strict audit independence.
  • Ability to build scalable audit infrastructure: Experience establishing risk-based internal audit methodologies, automated sampling procedures, and testing frameworks that scale from early-stage authorization to high-volume cross-border operations.

Nice to Have

  • Cross-Border & FX Audit Experience: Background auditing foreign exchange (Câmbio/eFX), international remittance rails, and multi-currency liquidity settlement.
  • Digital Assets & Crypto Auditing: Practical knowledge auditing blockchain transactions, digital asset custody (Res. BCB 520), and stablecoin flows (USDT/USDC).
  • Professional Certifications: Active CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CFA, or active CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade).
  • RegTech & Automation Tools: Experience testing or auditing automated transaction monitoring, automated BACEN reporting software, and reconciliation engines.

Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Aeronautical Electrical Systems Designer - Senior
description:
Summary Description

We are looking for a Senior Aeronautical Electrical Systems Designer to work on the development, integration, and detailing of electrical systems in civil and military aeronautical programs. The professional will be responsible for technical leading design activities, proposing robust solutions for highly complex systems, and acting as a technical reference for the team, contributing to all phases of the product development cycle, from conception to certification.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop aeronautical hydromechanical installation projects in a 3D CAD environment;
  • Prepare installation layouts, integration drawings, and technical documentation;
  • Develop solutions for the installation of hydraulic, environmental (AMS/ECS), fuel, propulsion, and other embedded mechanical systems;
  • Specify aeronautical components, materials, piping, hoses, connections, and hardware;
  • Prepare bills of materials (BOM) and engineering documentation;
  • Develop integration solutions between hydromechanical systems, structures, electrical systems, and avionics;
  • Perform system integration and segregation analyses;
  • Support the manufacturing, installation, and integration of systems;
  • Support development testing, qualification, and certification activities;
  • Participate in the analysis of technical requirements and their implementation in the project;
  • Interact with clients, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams in defining technical solutions;
  • Prepare engineering documentation according to internal processes and certification requirements;
  • Provide technical support to junior professionals and contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes.

Requirements

Education

• Technical course in Electrical, Electronics, Electrotechnics, Mechatronics or related areas.

Desirable:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronic, Mechatronics, Aeronautical Engineering or related area

Experience

  • Over 10 years of experience in the design of aeronautical electrical systems.
  • Proven experience in aircraft development, modification or certification programs.

Technical knowledge

Electrical Systems Design Project

  • Design and detailing of aeronautical electrical installations;
  • Preparation and interpretation of electrical diagrams;
  • Development of wiring diagrams;
  • Preparation of wire lists and bills of materials (BOM);
  • Design of wiring routing (EWIS);
  • Installation of onboard electrical and electronic equipment;
  • Definition of supports, fixings, and mechanical interfaces;
  • Specification of hardware, materials, connectors, and aeronautical components;
  • Reading and interpretation of technical drawings and engineering documentation.

Aeronautical Knowledge

  • Aeronautical Product Development Process;
  • EWIS (Electrical Wiring Interconnection System);
  • Integration and segregation of systems;
  • Aeronautical manufacturing and assembly process;
  • Best practices for the installation of aeronautical systems;
  • Development, qualification, and certification testing;
  • Application of Service Bulletins and major modifications (STC);
  • Certification process for civil and military aircraft.

Tools

Desirable experience with tools such as:

  • CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE;
  • E3.series (Zuken) or IGE+XAO;
  • Microsoft Office.

Desired skills

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills;
  • Organization and planning skills;
  • Good verbal and written communication skills;
  • Multidisciplinary teamwork skills;
  • Strong interpersonal skills;
  • Collaborative and results-oriented profile;
  • Proactive and responsible;
  • Ability to work in a dynamic environment;
  • Flexibility to handle changing priorities;
  • Commitment to quality, safety, and deadlines.

Desirable Skills

Experience in the following areas will be considered a plus:

  • Large-scale aeronautical modification projects (STC);
  • Civil or military certification programs;
  • Hydraulic flight control systems;
  • Fuel systems;
  • Environmental systems (ECS/AMS);
  • Pneumatic systems;
  • Engine and APU installation;
  • Integration of special and mission systems;
  • DOORS, Polarion, or requirements management tools;
  • FAR/CS 23 or 25 standards;
  • ARP4754A, ARP4761 and DO-160;
  • ANAC, FAA or EASA certification processes.

Languages

  • Intermediate English (reading and interpreting technical documentation).
  • Advanced English will be considered a plus.

Availability

  • National and international travel, when necessary.
  • Willingness to work different shifts as needed by projects.

What do we expect

We are looking for professionals passionate about aeronautical engineering, with solid technical experience and the ability to lead highly complex solutions. We expect individuals committed to excellence in engineering, who work collaboratively, positively influence team development, and contribute to the delivery of safe, innovative, and certifiable projects, strengthening the technical capacity and competitiveness of Systems Engineering.

title: Mars Program — MBA Leadership
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international brand of Meituan, the world's leading food delivery platform. Guided by the mission of "helping people eat better and live better," we bring 15 years of Meituan's technology and operational expertise to global markets. Since launching in 2023, we have grown from Hong Kong to the Middle East and Brazil — building real value for users, merchants, and delivery partners in every community we serve.

About Mars Program

Mars Program is Keeta's flagship leadership accelerator — a strategic investment in the next generation of business leaders for Brazil. This is not a traditional hire. We are looking for high-potential talents who want to build a long-term career in Brazil, understand the food delivery business end-to-end, and grow into future leaders of this organization.

You will be assigned to one of the four core pillars of our business — Merchant, Consumer, Delivery, and Business Analytics — gaining a comprehensive, hands-on understanding of what it takes to build and scale a world-class food delivery platform.

What You'll Do

Your responsibilities will evolve across business areas, and may include:

  • Drive merchant acquisition, activation, and retention strategies to grow Keeta's supply-side ecosystem in Brazil.
  • Design and execute consumer growth and retention initiatives, tailoring strategies to local user behavior and market dynamics.
  • Optimize delivery operations — improving efficiency, rider experience, and fulfillment quality in the Brazilian market.
  • Conduct business analysis to translate data into strategic insights, supporting key decisions across functions.
  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects, collaborating with local and global teams to solve real business challenges.

What We're Looking For

  • Education: Full-time international MBA required. We seek candidates who have completed or are completing a full-time MBA program, bringing a global perspective and the academic foundation to lead in a complex, fast-growing market.
  • Background: Experience in consulting, finance, tech, fast-moving consumer goods, or management trainee programs is a strong fit. Candidates from outside the industry with demonstrated high potential are equally welcome.
  • Language: Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Mindset: Humble, hands-on, curious, resilient — excited by the ambiguity of building something from scratch, not just managing what's already there.

Why Join Mars Program

  • High Starting Point — a dual recognition of your past achievements and future potential. This is our commitment to attracting top talent.
  • End-to-End Business Exposure — specialize in one of our four core pillars. Build the holistic view and foundational logic of the food delivery business that most professionals spend a decade trying to piece together.
  • Executive Mentorship & Visibility — Enter a high-visibility talent pool with direct access to senior leadership, intensive coaching, and exposure to real strategic decisions.
  • World-Class Methodology — Benefit from Meituan's 15 years of deep industry know-how and scientific operating frameworks, now being applied to crack one of the world's most exciting new markets.

Work Location: São Paulo, Brazil.

Onboarding Target: September 2026

Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (PwD). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

title: Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern
description:

The Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern provides administrative, scheduling, and operational support to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager in the coordination and execution of events across Graded.

A primary responsibility is to support reservations and scheduling for Art Center spaces, including the Black Box Theatre, Haddad Center, Art Gallery, classrooms, and other designated areas. The Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern also assists with event records, calendar updates, service requests, purchase orders, payment processes, event preparation, and on-site logistical support.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities

Art Center Reservations & Scheduling

  • Support reservations and scheduling for Art Center spaces.
  • Review requests, check availability, identify scheduling conflicts, and maintain accurate reservation records.
  • Enter and update approved reservations in EvM and relevant school calendars.
  • Communicate confirmations, changes, and space-use information to requesters.
  • Follow up on missing information and escalate conflicts or exceptions to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.

Event Management System & Calendar Support

  • Maintain organized event records, files, spreadsheets, and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with the creation of purchase orders in the ERP system, payment requests, and process follow-up.
  • Support faculty and staff with routine questions related to reservations and event procedures.

Event Coordination & Administrative Support

  • Assist with event setup and breakdown and help ensure spaces are ready for scheduled use.
  • Support guest reception, registration, wayfinding, and other event-day activities as needed.
  • Monitor assigned event spaces and report operational, maintenance, safety, or facility concerns.
  • Help ensure spaces are properly reset following events.
  • Support evening and weekend events when required and permitted within the internship schedule.
  • Assist with the creation of purchase orders in the ERP system, as well as with payment requests and follow-up throughout the process.

Art Center Space Readiness

  • Conduct routine checks of Art Center spaces in connection with scheduled reservations and events.
  • Help ensure that reserved spaces are organized and ready for use.
  • Identify and report concerns related to cleanliness, furniture, audiovisual equipment, maintenance, safety, or general facility conditions.
  • Support the organization of event supplies, signage, materials, and other shared resources.
  • Report discrepancies between approved reservations and actual space usage to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.
  • Assist in maintaining organized records related to Art Center space utilization and recurring operational needs.

Professional Practice

  • Work under the direction of the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager and collaborate professionally with different school departments.
  • Maintain confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries with students.
  • Comply with Graded's Child Safeguarding Code of Conduct, policies, and procedures.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, reliability, organization, and a service-oriented approach.
  • Perform other internship-related duties as assigned by the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.

Certifications and Education

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree program eligible for a formal internship.

Experience

  • Previous internship, volunteer, university, or extracurricular experience involving events, administration, customer service, scheduling, or project support.
  • Familiarity with calendars, spreadsheets, reservation systems, or event management tools.

title: Remote M&A Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M&A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents.
  • Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing.
  • Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W&I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising M&A or corporate law in private practice or in-house.
  • End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams.
  • Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics.
  • Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on.
  • Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:

title: Especialista em Projeção de Mercado - Vaga Afirmativa para Mulheres
description:
Sobre a empresa: Empresa de grande porte, atuante no setor de fornecimento e distribuição de energia elétrica.

Buscamos uma profissional para atuar como Especialista em Projeção de Mercado, integrando a área de Projeção de Mercado e sendo responsável pela construção de projeções de longo prazo relacionadas ao comportamento energético e financeiro da companhia, apoiando decisões estratégicas e contribuindo diretamente para a geração de receita.

  • Interagir com diferentes áreas internas para alinhamento de premissas e validação dos resultados;
  • Elaborar estudos analíticos para suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Construir apresentações executivas, traduzindo análises técnicas e dados complexos em informações claras e objetivas;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, sendo referência técnica para temas relacionados à projeção de mercado e modelagem preditiva.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Formação superior completa em Estatística, Engenharia, Economia, Matemática, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida com modelagem estatística, econometria e séries temporais;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de modelos preditivos e forecasting;
  • Conhecimento em Python, R e SQL;
  • Capacidade analítica avançada e facilidade para trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados;
  • Pensamento crítico, visão sistêmica e capacidade de estruturar problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos;
  • Organização e clareza na construção de análises e narrativas técnicas.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com Machine Learning aplicado a séries temporais;
  • Experiência com projeção de demanda, carga, consumo ou mercado de energia;

title: Recepcionista
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A MBRAS atua no mercado imobiliário de alto padrão com uma visão integrada de patrimônio, curadoria e inteligência. Em nossa operação, cada interação representa a marca, o cuidado com o relacionamento e a qualidade da experiência oferecida a clientes, parceiros e visitantes.

Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar na recepção da MBRAS, sendo o primeiro ponto de contato presencial e telefônico da empresa.

Esta posição exige comunicação clara, apresentação profissional, organização e atenção consistente aos detalhes. A pessoa será responsável por acolher visitantes, apoiar a rotina administrativa e contribuir para que agendas, reuniões e demandas do dia a dia sejam conduzidas com fluidez.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Recepcionar clientes, visitantes e parceiros com cordialidade, discrição e postura profissional.
  • Gerenciar chamadas telefônicas, mensagens e direcionamentos às áreas responsáveis.
  • Apoiar a organização de agendas, reuniões, salas e compromissos da diretoria.
  • Dar suporte à preparação de materiais administrativos, planilhas e apresentações.
  • Organizar documentos, registros e arquivos físicos e digitais.
  • Apoiar a operação de eventos, reuniões internas e atendimentos presenciais.
  • Zelar pela organização e apresentação dos espaços de recepção e salas de reunião.

Perfil buscado

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Postura profissional, discrição e atenção à experiência de atendimento.
  • Organização, senso de prioridade e capacidade de acompanhar diferentes demandas simultaneamente.
  • Autonomia, proatividade e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Facilidade de relacionamento com diferentes públicos.
  • Domínio de ferramentas administrativas e digitais.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em recepção, atendimento, secretaria executiva, hotelaria ou rotinas administrativas.
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Excel.
  • Conhecimento de PowerPoint, Canva ou ferramentas equivalentes para apoio na elaboração de apresentações.
  • Familiaridade com Google Workspace e Microsoft Office.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em São Paulo.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas de serviços, hospitalidade, mercado imobiliário, arquitetura, design, varejo premium ou ambientes corporativos de alto padrão.
  • Vivência no suporte a diretoria ou equipes executivas.
  • Inglês básico ou intermediário.
  • Residência na Zona Sul de São Paulo ou facilidade de acesso à região da Cidade Jardim.

Informações da vaga

  • Modelo de trabalho: Presencial
  • Localização: São Paulo, SP, região da Cidade Jardim
  • Tipo de contratação: Tempo integral
  • Área: Recepção e Suporte Administrativo

Diversidade e inclusão

A MBRAS valoriza diferentes trajetórias, perspectivas e experiências. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas com respeito, confidencialidade e critérios alinhados aos requisitos da posição.

title: Vendedor 0KM

title: Aprendiz Administrativo
description:
Somos a ADM do Brasil, presente em mais de 200 países e contamos com quase 40 mil colaboradores pelo globo.

Aqui trabalhamos forte para liberar o poder da natureza e enriquecer a sua qualidade de vida e da sua família! Que tal nos conhecermos melhor? #teamADM

Gosta estar em contato com diferentes culturas? Valoriza aprender sobre diferentes costumes? Acesso o nosso site:

Na ADM, a definição de diversidade é ampla, abrangendo não apenas a diversidade de raça, gênero, identidade sexual, etnia, origens econômicas e educacionais, mas também de experiências, perspectivas e interesses. Também garantimos que nossa força de trabalho tenha oportunidades iguais para desenvolver suas carreiras dentro da empresa e tenha a oportunidade de contribuir com sua maneira única de pensar em nossos negócios.

Adicionalmente, se você possui qualquer tipo de deficiência você é bem-vindo (a) à equipe da ADM. Somos um empregador igualitário e inclusivo e queremos propor um ambiente saudável e adequado ao seu desenvolvimento. A ADM busca ativamente pessoas com deficiência para integrar ao seu time.

Carregamos conosco ampla riqueza cultural, pois acreditamos que a diversidade amplia visão, traz inovação e contribui para os nossos talentos!

Jovem Aprendiz

Oportunidade: Jovem Aprendiz.

Aprender as atividades de suporte da área administrativa, contribuindo com a organização, separação e arquivo de documentos, atendimento aos clientes internos e externos, lançamento de dados em sistemas e planilhas.

  • Aprender as atividades de suporte da área administrativa e dar suporte nessas atividades.
  • Separar, organizar e arquivar documentos do setor administrativo.

  • Ensino médio completo ou cursando (último ano);
